en: Oh no! Muddy hands, after playing outside! What do we do?
<SAW> once said: Cleanliness is half of faith!
Wow! So let's get clean! Wash your hands with soap. Bubbles everywhere!
Brush your teeth, up and down, until they sparkle!
Comb your hair, and put on clean clothes.
Allah loves those who keep clean, and everyone loves a fresh, clean hug!
What will you keep clean today? Tell your grown-up!
